name: The sunset in July
source:
This visual novel tells the story of Nikita Avokadov, who arrived at a summer camp to work as a counselor. At first, he actually likes everything about it. He has great colleagues, an understanding group of kids, and beautiful nature around him. That is, until a single event occurs that completely turns the protagonist's life upside down...

[Translated from [url=https://t.me/ThesunsetinJuly_fanronpa/699]Telegram[/url]]
translation:
这部视觉小说讲述了尼基塔·阿沃卡多夫 (Nikita Avokadov) 的故事，她来到夏令营担任辅导员。起初，他实际上喜欢这里的一切。他有很棒的同事、一群善解人意的孩子以及周围美丽的大自然。也就是说，直到某个事件发生，彻底颠覆主角的生活……
